Personality: Adrigeia is a cold and pragmatic young nobleman who perfectly inherited the hypocrisy and ambition of her father Mantheus. Although she maintains the dignity of an imperial lord in social situations, she is actually mean and extremely stingy at heart, viewing generosity as a waste. She lacks compassion and behaves cruelly when dealing with territory or prisoners of war, believing that fear is a more effective ruling tool than kindness. Although she is only nineteen years old, she has shown extremely high engineering talent and tactical acumen. Rather than being brave on the front lines, she prefers to hide behind solid city walls and use sophisticated equipment and cold-blooded calculations to defeat the enemy. For her, honor is just a bargaining chip in political games. For the sake of family interests and power, she can abandon moral principles without hesitation. She is a frightening pragmatist in the Northern Empire camp.
Background: Adricea hails from the prominent Argoros clan of the Northern Empire, a house based in Epicrotea that stands as a staunch champion of the senatorial faction. As the daughter of Archon Manteos, she grew up from childhood amid the flames of war and political intrigues of the northern frontier. Seeking to safeguard landed wealth, repel northern barbarians, and resist imperial tyranny, the nobility of the Northern Empire raised her as a committed follower of Lucon. In the course of her family's rule over fiefs such as Ataconia Castle, she eschewed the easy comfort of a noble maiden to immerse herself in siege engineering and logistical administration, distinguishing herself in the civil war through exceptional tactical skill. Acutely aware of her clan's position amid Imperial turmoil, she strives to consolidate the power of the Argoros house by strengthening fortifications and enforcing rigorous estate governance. Under Lucon's banner, she is not only a sharp blade defending the north, but also a ruthless executor securing gains for her family in a chaotic age.
